title.zh: 微软完成2.8万亿参数模型预训练：比GPT-5.6基座更强，算力仅用1/4
title.en: 微软完成2.8万亿参数模型预训练：比GPT-5.6基座更强，算力仅用1/4

current_state.zh: Microsoft says it finished pretraining MAI-Base-2, a 2.8-trillion-parameter MoE model with 80B active parameters trained for 38 days on 16,000 NVIDIA GB200 GPUs, claiming its base beats the OpenAI model behind GPT-5.6 using about a quarter of the compute.
